title: Who is your Percy Jackson godly parent? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Percy Jackson quiz: answer 12 questions to find your godly parent, from Zeus, Poseidon and Hades to Athena, Apollo, Ares, Aphrodite and Hermes. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Who is your Percy Jackson godly parent?
lede: Which cabin would claim you at Camp Half-Blood? Answer 12 questions about quests, fears and your fatal flaw to find out which Greek god is your godly parent.
about: In Rick Riordan's Percy Jackson and the Olympians books, the children of Greek gods grow up in the modern world and train at Camp Half-Blood, where each lives in their godly parent's cabin. This quiz matches you with eight of those gods: Zeus, Poseidon, Hades, Athena, Apollo, Ares, Aphrodite and Hermes.

Your result names your godly parent and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rick Riordan, his publishers or Disney; the names and characters of the series belong to their owners.

faq.q: Which godly parents can I get?
faq.a: Zeus, Poseidon, Hades, Athena, Apollo, Ares, Aphrodite and Hermes. Your result names your main parent and shows your score for all eight.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every god appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely, including the Big Three.

faq.q: Why isn't my favorite god here?
faq.a: Eight results keep the quiz short and fair. Demeter, Hephaestus, Dionysus and others may join in a later update.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

items.q: A monster bursts into camp. You…
options: Head for the water, where you feel strongest
Lure it into a trap you just thought up
Calm your friends down, and maybe charm the monster too
Shooting from afar and healing the wounded
Leading from the front and giving orders

items.q: A free afternoon at camp. You spend it…

options: You care too much what people think of you
You always have to be in charge
The top of a skyscraper, as high as you can get
A hidden island in the open sea
A cave nobody has ever come back from

items.q: Which camp activity do you sign up for?

options: The smart one with a plan
Easygoing and loyal, until someone crosses you

items.q: A prophecy says a friend will betray you. You…
options: Try to trick fate before it happens
Keep your secrets and trust no one
Work out what the verse really means
Challenge every suspect to a fight

items.q: The gift you'd most like from the gods:
options: A book that answers any question

items.q: How do you travel on a quest?
options: Fast and light, with a shortcut nobody knows
In a convertible with the music up

items.q: You've just won a fight. You…
options: Look around for the next one
Study how to win better next time
Make sure everyone saw how good you looked
Vanish before anyone can thank you

zeus.name: Zeus, god of the sky
zeus.body: You are a born leader with big ambitions and a commanding presence. People look to you when decisions need making. You like being in control, so remember that even the king of the gods needs allies.

poseidon.name: Poseidon, god of the sea
poseidon.body: You are loyal, easygoing and stubborn in equal measure. You'd do anything for your friends, and you stay calm until someone crosses you. Then, like the sea, you're hard to stop.

hades.name: Hades, god of the underworld
hades.body: You are private, serious and more loyal than people realize. You're at home on your own and aren't scared of dark places. Let a few people in: you have more friends than you think.

athena.name: Athena, goddess of wisdom
athena.body: You are clever and strategic, and always have a plan. You win with your head, not your fists. You find it hard to admit you're wrong, so remember that the best plans leave room for other people's ideas.

apollo.name: Apollo, god of the sun, music and healing
apollo.body: You are bright, talented and hard to ignore. Art, music and helping people come naturally to you. You enjoy an audience, so make sure you're listening as well as performing.

ares.name: Ares, god of war
ares.body: You are brave and competitive, and you never back down. You charge in where others hesitate, and that can save the day. Pick your fights: not every problem needs a spear.

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite, goddess of love
aphrodite.body: You are charming and understand people better than they understand themselves. You can win a room over without raising your voice. There is more to you than looks, and your real power is knowing what people feel.

hermes.name: Hermes, god of travelers and thieves
hermes.body: You are quick, funny and always on the move. You know a shortcut, a trick or a person for every problem. You hate being tied down, but your friends count on you to show up, so do.
